tempmail.mdd: Here is an address you can throw away.
tempmail.code.label: Looks like a verification code
tempmail.list.empty: No mail yet. send something to the address above (checked every 5 seconds)
tempmail.status.ready: Address ready. copy it and use it
tempmail.status.resumed: Carrying on with the address from this tab
tempmail.status.gone: That address is gone. make a new one
tempmail.status.noRelay: Could not reach the mail server. try opening this again in a moment
tempmail.status.notOn: Receiving is not switched on yet. an address would never get any mail
tempmail.note.limits: You can give the address to anyone. the mail only opens in this tab (the reading key lives here and disappears with the tab). Attachments are not accepted. Up to 20 letters, 256KB each; once the lifetime is up it is gone from the server too. HTML mail is flattened to text on arrival.
